note: Phase B extracted scoped, provisional claims from existing research. PARTIAL is not FULL-PASS; no native verification was newly performed.

items.evidence_scope: KR 0x807A70 conditional successful local outbound frame writer, including guards
items.assertion: For valid positive payload length and other output-ring guards, writer 0x807A70 writes LE16 payload length, LE16 marker 0x1A68, then unchanged payload. Total local frame bytes=len+4. Payload maximum for this writer is 0x0FFC.
limitations: Local buffer framing success does not show socket send or complete connection protocol.
Guarded normal return path; unknown session-level mode and error handling.

items.evidence_scope: KR 0x807830 conditional successful local outbound frame writer
items.assertion: For positive payload with len+6<=0x1000 and ring guards, writer 0x807830 constructs [LE16 payload length, LE16 0x0BBB, LE16 sum(plaintext bytes) mod 65536] followed by payload XOR: first byte xor 0xB6; later bytes xor previous plaintext byte.
limitations: This describes framing in the local outbound buffer, not a captured network transmission.
Do not infer all nonzero modes always emit this frame; fallback exists.

items.evidence_scope: KR 0x8061A0 connection+0xA02C dispatch and writer return path
items.assertion: For mode byte ==0 consumer chooses 0x807A70; for nonzero it attempts 0x807830 and falls back to 0x807A70 on failure.
limitations: Mode writer/init and actual time-dependent switching not complete.
Conditional code-path behavior, not full end-to-end Server wire sequence.

items.evidence_scope: KR 0x807B40 observed inbound frame parser branch
items.assertion: Receiver reads LE16 payload length (nonzero, at most 0x1000), discriminator at +2, marker 0x2633=>8-byte header, 0x0BBB=>6, otherwise 4 (including 0x1A68 and 0x22D7); incomplete input is retained; 0x0BBB path checks reconstructed-byte sum.
limitations: Unknown markers reaching default header4 is not proof of valid business packets.
Checksum mismatch branch may still reach common record handling; exact discard semantics not certified.
0x2633 transformation and complete queue downstream not closed.

items.evidence_scope: KR 0x4B7DC0 registration and 0x4B7F00 command-2 roster record loop
items.assertion: Handler registered at dispatch command index 2 uses 65-byte payload prefix followed by 53-byte records; bounded record count on path reaching loop is floor((payload_length-65)/53), first record offset 65.
limitations: Some earlier header fields are read before count calculation: short payload is not proven safe.
Payload trailing non-whole records are not counted but are not validated away.
Another consumer uses a 2-byte prefix; do not conflate.

items.evidence_scope: KR 0x4B7F00 ID guard and 0x4D4150 copy interface
items.assertion: Record byte offset +0x2E is ID selection byte; observed guard accepts unsigned ID <=9 when valid destination, then copies record into UI entry at F94304+ID*0x210; leaf copies NUL-terminated UTF-16 name from record +0; byte +0x2F/+0x30 and DWORD +0x31/+0x2A feed specific UI fields. Availability flag +0x5C is set in leaf.
limitations: No proved official valid-ID policy or deduplication; ID0 not thereby certified.
Source UTF-16 must fit buffers and terminate; unsafe synthetic input is not certified.
UI record write is not proof of full UI refresh, authorization or scene entry.

items.evidence_scope: KR client auth payload builders 0x4A3360/0x4A31B0 and 0x440790 mode selection
items.assertion: Observed outbound command 0x00E8 has 112-byte local payload: 2-byte LE command, byte slots +2..52 and +53..103 of capacity 51, unknown +104..109, common source word +110..111. Command 0x000F has 214-byte local payload: two 51 UTF-16-word slots at +2..103 and +104..205, explicit DWORD +206..209 0x00010001, WORD +210..211 0x0034, common source word +212..213.
limitations: Neither proves official credential validation or accepted character length.
Codepage, exact source data, conversion failures and E8 opaque tail unknown.
Two commands are not interchangeable; these are client payload builders, not complete wire frames.

items.evidence_scope: KR client login-result consumer 0x4C37A0 conditional status path and 0x4C3080 group/channel records
items.assertion: Observed consumer branches on status byte at payload+0x16. Status 0 with nonempty wide name at +2 enters data-update path; status 5 is separate nonsuccess branch. Group records in 0x4C3080 use 3-byte group header (uint16 ID + uint8 channel count) and 10-byte channel rows with IPv4 octets at row+4..7.
limitations: Status enum semantics and complete returned-packet validation not established.
Group cursor, opaque fields, identity capacity, and world connection handoff require further examination.
Cannot infer server endpoint policy, auth policy, or successful end-to-end login.

items.evidence_scope: KR 0x5452C0 example C2S input route, 0x8069A0/0x8060D0/0x806060/0x8061A0, 0x804A40, 0x8068B0 and 0x806FC0
items.assertion: On the bounded static input path, the Client routes payload by a connection slot key, queues and frames it, and reaches an overlapped WSASend call through 0x804A40/0x8068B0; a separate 0x806FC0 routine performs socket shutdown/close cleanup.
limitations: Does not prove remote server receipt, actual packet count, ACK, full failure/retry and every Client send path.
Do not describe A0A4 as proven queue length; T01 requires qualification.

items.evidence_scope: KR 0x806CF0 completion, 0x807B40 frame parser, 0x8040A0 queued delivery, 0x804740 pump and 0x4930E0 callback
items.assertion: A bounded received-data route crosses WSARecv/IOCP completion, frame parsing into a queued decoded payload, and CClient callback 0x4930E0; on channel==2 it reads decoded payload's initial word for command handling.
limitations: Native behavior on malformed frames, checksum mismatch, pool initialization, dropped nodes and channel!=2 not fully established.
Known bounded route not all possible network or interprocess paths.

items.evidence_scope: KR 0x806AD0 Connect(address,port,slot,pipeline) and observed callsites at 0x49575B/0x4957EA/0x495803
items.assertion: The bounded KR Client paths call Connect with (port 8415,slot1,pipeline2), (port8416,slot0,pipeline2), and (port8414,slot2,pipeline2); slot is used as outbound network map lookup key and pipeline is stored in connection+A080 for receive delivery.
limitations: These are historic KR static callsite constants, not a live endpoint guarantee or a normative Server listen-port requirement.
Direct-call scan excludes aliased and computed calls; slot/pipeline are not actors or owner IDs.

items.evidence_scope: KR 0x4930E0 and downstream CClient processor/scene dispatch, including 0x4C4670/0x4FDA30 tables
items.assertion: Decoded inbound payload first word acts as a command index on the observed channel2 path; Client processor dispatch can select a Scene-specific override table and a general fallback, making observed handler behavior dependent on scene state.
limitations: Exact handler behaviors and all overrides are not a complete business protocol contract.
Do not equate equal numerical C2S and S2C command indices with identical messages.

items.evidence_scope: KR Event.stp EX v1 SceneList.xml decryption/decompression sample, restored 158269 bytes
items.assertion: The bounded KR Event.stp EX v1 sample was decoded into a SceneList.xml file containing a scene row questIdx=1001, sceneIdx=1, funcName=tutorial_start, endBehavior=0. The source report counts 1687 SCENE children.
limitations: Static resource table is not evidence of a Server packet, first-login branch, or every player's default scene.
The raw extracted XML was not provided in this S00 branch; S00 did not independently rerun original resource bytes.

items.evidence_scope: KR 0x5607D0/0x568950/0x568680 SceneList two-key index and Event.stp tutorial_start Lua source
items.assertion: The bounded Client SceneList loader extracts questIdx, sceneIdx and funcName, then places the first two as a two-key ordered index to the associated script name; Event.stp includes a Lua tutorial_start function source snippet.
limitations: The observed source snippet does not prove scene startup or define a full native extracted script file length.
Do not interpret the XML key pair as S2C wire field semantics.

items.evidence_scope: KR SceneList ordered-map readers 0x561A1C... and 0x5658D0... path builder; E13 original scope
items.assertion: At least two bounded Client readers use a SceneList (questIdx,sceneIdx) index hit to assemble Event/Sequences/<funcName>.seq from the selected node.
limitations: Later E14–E16 correct details about callee function names, first path loader and external resource calls; prefer newer bounded findings.
Path construction does not establish that the script ran successfully or that the chosen keys came from a character-selection packet.

items.evidence_scope: KR 0x47B5C0→0x565720, 0x561EF3 EndCutScene→0x565720 and dual script load evidence
items.assertion: The same bounded scene index/load entry 0x565720 is reached from at least two distinct upstream paths, including a 0x47B5C0 state branch and a post-EndCutScene restoration path; therefore it is not proven specific to first login.
limitations: The [object+0x248] writer, origin of key/state values and direct 0x42 selection response integration remain unknown.
Static paths do not establish successful runtime invocation, actual Server packet or scene transition.
